root_cause.text: The `fib6_add_rt2node()` function in the IPv6 routing subsystem performs an unconditional read of the `fib6_nh` member within `struct fib6_info` without verifying that the structure actually contains this trailing member, which is omitted when routes are created using `RTA_NH_ID`.
root_cause.evidence: The KASAN report identifies a slab-out-of-bounds read at `fib6_add_rt2node` accessing `iter->fib6_nh->fib_nh_gw_family`, and the commit message explicitly states that "When IPv6 route is created with RTA_NH_ID, struct fib6_info does not have the trailing struct fib6_nh," prompting the fix to check `iter->nh` before accessing `iter->fib6_nh`.
